target_user: Auburn-area student housing operators, leasing managers, and apartment marketers
core_problem: They need sharper, faster local intelligence on pricing, student preferences, amenity tradeoffs, and leasing messaging, but existing inputs are fragmented, generic, or too slow.
job_to_be_done: Help a local operator decide how to price, market, and position properties to student renters with more confidence.
usage_pattern: monthly or biweekly reporting with heavier use during leasing season
